content.text: {"issues":[{"where":"Research Question 1 – Phase 1","problem":"The plan assigns annotation of 500 held-out transcript segments to no named party and budgets no time or staff for it; neither side's records show annotators or a crowd-sourcing capability.","fix":"Add an explicit task in Phase 1 assigning the university research assistant to recruit and manage five annotators (or use an existing Serbian NLP annotation resource), with a named deliverable."},{"where":"Research Question 2 – Phase 3","problem":"A single six-month prototype run on live inventory cannot isolate the embedding layer's effect on CTR from confounding factors such as seasonal ad demand and campaign mix changes, so the measure cannot confirm the layer 'raises' CTR rather than correlating with it.","fix":"Reframe the measure as a controlled A/B split of SoundSlot inventory (embedding-matched vs. current demographic targeting) over a defined window, and name the company data analyst as responsible for setting up and reporting the split."}],"unconfirmed":[]}
